	type = character_event
	theme = stewardship
	title = zg361cp.131.t
	desc = zg361cp.131.desc
	trigger = {
		is_ai = no
		exists = scope:zg361_cp_r_owner
		exists = scope:zg361_cp_r_subject
		exists = scope:zg361_cp_r_cycle
		exists = scope:zg361_cp_r_case
		this = scope:zg361_cp_r_owner
		zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
		scope:zg361_cp_r_subject = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_r_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_r_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_r_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_r_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_r_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_r_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = scope:zg361_cp_r_owner

				EXPECTED_CYCLE = scope:zg361_cp_r_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = scope:zg361_cp_r_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = 1
			}
		}
	}
	immediate = {
		scope:zg361_cp_r_subject = {
			zg361_cp_clear_pending_player_event_effect = { EVENT = 131 }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zg361cp.131.a

		trigger = {
			scope:zg361_cp_r_subject = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = zg361_cp_portfolio_deferred }
					var:zg361_cp_portfolio_deferred = 0
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
			}
		}
		scope:zg361_cp_r_subject = {
			zg361_cp_m131_route_a_effect = {
				TICKET_OWNER = scope:zg361_cp_r_owner
				TICKET_SUBJECT = scope:zg361_cp_r_subject
				TICKET_CYCLE = scope:zg361_cp_r_cycle
				TICKET_CASE = scope:zg361_cp_r_case
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:zg361_cp_r_subject = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { has_variable = zg361_cp_runtime_applied }
						var:zg361_cp_runtime_applied = 1
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
			}
			scope:zg361_cp_r_subject = { set_variable = { name = zg361_cp_pending_player_event value = 129 } }

				TICKET_SUBJECT = scope:zg361_cp_r_subject
				TICKET_CYCLE = scope:zg361_cp_r_cycle
				TICKET_CASE = scope:zg361_cp_r_case
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:zg361_cp_r_subject = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { has_variable = zg361_cp_runtime_applied }
						var:zg361_cp_runtime_applied = 1
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
			}
			scope:zg361_cp_r_subject = { set_variable = { name = zg361_cp_pending_player_event value = 133 } }
			trigger_event = { id = zg361cp.133 days = 1 }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zg361cp.132.c
		custom_tooltip = zg361cp.132.c.tt

		scope:zg361_cp_r_subject = {
			zg361_cp_m132_route_c_effect = {
				TICKET_OWNER = scope:zg361_cp_r_owner
				TICKET_SUBJECT = scope:zg361_cp_r_subject
				TICKET_CYCLE = scope:zg361_cp_r_cycle
				TICKET_CASE = scope:zg361_cp_r_case
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:zg361_cp_r_subject = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { has_variable = zg361_cp_runtime_applied }
						var:zg361_cp_runtime_applied = 1
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
			}
			scope:zg361_cp_r_subject = { set_variable = { name = zg361_cp_pending_player_event value = 133 } }
			trigger_event = { id = zg361cp.133 days = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# #133 — Learning and Liability Need Separate Tracks
zg361cp.133 = {
	type = character_event
	theme = stewardship
	title = zg361cp.133.t
	desc = zg361cp.133.desc
	trigger = {
		is_ai = no
		exists = scope:zg361_cp_r_owner
		exists = scope:zg361_cp_r_subject
		exists = scope:zg361_cp_r_cycle
		exists = scope:zg361_cp_r_case
		this = scope:zg361_cp_r_owner
		zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes
		scope:zg361_cp_r_subject = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_r_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_r_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_r_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_r_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_r_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_r_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = scope:zg361_cp_r_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = scope:zg361_cp_r_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = scope:zg361_cp_r_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = scope:zg361_cp_r_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = 5
			}
		}
	}
	immediate = {
		scope:zg361_cp_r_subject = {
			zg361_cp_clear_pending_player_event_effect = { EVENT = 133 }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zg361cp.133.a

		trigger = {
			scope:zg361_cp_r_subject = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = zg361_cp_portfolio_deferred }
					OR = {
						var:zg361_cp_portfolio_deferred = 0
						AND = {
							has_variable = zg361_cp_player_batch_mode
							var:zg361_cp_player_batch_mode = 3
						}
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
			}
		}
		scope:zg361_cp_r_subject = {
			zg361_cp_m133_route_a_effect = {
				TICKET_OWNER = scope:zg361_cp_r_owner
				TICKET_SUBJECT = scope:zg361_cp_r_subject
				TICKET_CYCLE = scope:zg361_cp_r_cycle
				TICKET_CASE = scope:zg361_cp_r_case
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zg361cp.133.b

		trigger = {
			scope:zg361_cp_r_subject = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = zg361_cp_portfolio_deferred }
					OR = {
						var:zg361_cp_portfolio_deferred = 0
						AND = {
							has_variable = zg361_cp_player_batch_mode
							var:zg361_cp_player_batch_mode = 3
						}
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
			}
		}
		scope:zg361_cp_r_subject = {
			zg361_cp_m133_route_b_effect = {
				TICKET_OWNER = scope:zg361_cp_r_owner
				TICKET_SUBJECT = scope:zg361_cp_r_subject
				TICKET_CYCLE = scope:zg361_cp_r_cycle
				TICKET_CASE = scope:zg361_cp_r_case
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = zg361cp.133.c
		custom_tooltip = zg361cp.133.c.tt

		scope:zg361_cp_r_subject = {
			zg361_cp_m133_route_c_effect = {
				TICKET_OWNER = scope:zg361_cp_r_owner
				TICKET_SUBJECT = scope:zg361_cp_r_subject
				TICKET_CYCLE = scope:zg361_cp_r_cycle
				TICKET_CASE = scope:zg361_cp_r_case
			}
		}
	}
